contract: Three randomized mirrored ABBA/BAAB blocks; fresh processes with two warmups and five measured GPU command timestamps. Independent dyadic every-cell checks and poison/guard checks every round, outside timing. Preallocated buffers; this excludes the language runtime and is a shape-policy screen, not application throughput.
